spans.s:
m. (-रः)
1 A sort of reed or grass, (Saccharum sara.)
2 An arrow.
3 The upper part or cream of slightly curdled milk.
4 Mischief, injury, hurt.
n. (-रं)
1

Water.
2

Versed sine of an arc.
E.
शॄ to hurt, aff. अप्, also सर.

r. 10th cl. (शारयति)
1 To be weak.
2 To weaken.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Variegated, (in colour,)
2 Yellow.
m. (-रः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A piece or man at chess, backgammon, &c.
3 Hurting, injuring.
4 A mixture of blue and yellow, a green.
5 Spotting, variegating.
f. (-री)
Kuśa grass.
E.
शॄ to injure, अण् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what goes, occurring chiefly in composition, as अनुसर, अवसर, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 The thick part or coagulum of curds or milk, cream, &c.
2 Going, motion.
3 An arrow.
4 Saltness, salt.
n. (-रं)
1 A lake, a pool.
2 Water.
mf. (-रः-रा) or (री)
A cascade, a water-fall; also शर.
E.
सृ to go, aff. अप्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Best, excellent.
2 Irrefragable, (as an argument.)
m. (-रः)
1 The pith or sap of trees, &c.
2 Strength, vigour.
3 The essence of any things, the essential or vital part of it.
4 The substance or material part (of a speech, book, message, &c.)
5

Marrow.
6

Air, wind.
7 Sickness, disease.
8 Firmness, hardness.
9 The coagulum of curds, &c. cream.
10 Fresh butter.
11 Prowess, valour, heroism.
m. (-रः-री)
A man at chess, backgammon, &c.
n. (-रं)
1

Water.
2

Wealth.
3

Properity, fitness.
4

Steel.
5

(In rhetoric,) Climax.
f. (-रा)
Dūrbbā grass.
(-री)
The Shalik or Sārikā, (Turdus salica, BUC.)
E.
सृ to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 The stem of the

Saccharum.
2

The shaft of an arrow.
E.
शर, and काण्ड stem.

m. (-न्द्रः)
The autumnal moon.
E.
शरट्, and चन्द्र moon.

n. (-जं)
Butter made from new milk or milk one day old.
E.
शर cream, and ज born.

n. (-जं)
Fresh butter.
E.
सर cream, and ज produced.

n. (-जं)
Fresh butter.
E.
सार cream, and ज produced.

m. (-न्मा)
A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
शर a sort of grass, and जन्मन् birth: having been brought up in thickets of that grass.

m. (-टः)
1 A lizard, a chamæleon.
2 Safflower, the plant.
E.
शॄ to hurt, अटन् aff.; also सरट.

m. (-टः)
A lizard, a chameleon, a guana, &c.
E.
सृ to go, अटन् aff.; also शरट.

n. (-णं)
1 A house.
2 A preserver, a protector, what or who protects or preserves.
3 Preservation, protection, defence.
4 Killing, slaying.
f. (-णी)
A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
E.
श to injure, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Going, moving, who or what goes or moves.
n. (-णं)
1 Oxidized iron, either in the state of rust or filings.
2 Going, proceeding.
f. (-णा or णी)
1 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.)
2 A sort of Teori.
E.
सृ to go, aff. युच्, or ल्युट् fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्; also शरण, &c.

m. (-णः)
1 Dysentery, diarrhoea.
2 Hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.)
3 A counsellor and embassador from RĀVAṆA to RĀMA.
f. (-णी)
1 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.)
2 A canal, a small river.
E.
सृ to go, (causal form,) ल्युद aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Refugee, appellant, one who comes for protection or refuge.
E.
शरण protection, and आगत come.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Taken refuge.
E.
शरण, and आपन्न obtained.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Unfortunate, wretched, involved in calamity or ruin, and dependant on others for protection or aid.
E.
शरण protection, and अर्थिन् soliciting, requiring.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unfortunate, calamitous, distressed, ruined, (see the last.)
E.
शरण protection, aid, and अर्पक who causes to be afforded.

mf. (-णिः-णी)
A road, a path, a way.
E.
शॄ to hurt, अनि aff., more usually सरणि.

f. (-णिः-णी)
1 A road, a path, a way.
2 A straight or continuous line.
3 A disease of the throat.
E.
सृ to go, Uṇādi aff. अनि, and ङीष् optionally added; also शरणि, &c.

f. (-णिः)
1 A small river.
2 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.)
3 A drain, a canal or water-pipe.
E.
सृ to go, (causal form,) अनि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Seeking for an asylum or protection.
E.
शरण, and एषिन् who wishes.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A bird in general.
2 A lizard, a chamæleon.
3 A kind of ornament.
4 A rogue, a cheat.
5 A libertine, a lecher.
E.
शॄ to injure, (fruit, &c.) अण्डन् Uṇādi aff.; also सरण्ड.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A rogue, a cheat.
2 A sort of ornament.
3 A bird.
E.
सृ to go, Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्, more usually शरण्ड.

m. (-ण्डः)
A snake's egg.
E.
सृ to go, (causal form,) अण्डन् aff.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
To be protected or aided, poor, miserable, helpless.
n. (-ण्यं)
1 A protection, a protector, that which or who affords refuge and defence.
2 A house.
3 Protection, defence.
4 Injury, hurt.
E.
शॄ to hurt, Uṇādi अन्य; or शरण protection, and यत् aff. of fitness.

m. (-ण्युः)
1 A cloud.
2 Wind, air.
3 A protector, a defender.
E.
शॄ to injure, अन्यु aff.; also सरण्यु.

m. (-ण्युः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A cloud.
3 Water.
E.
सृ to go, अन्यु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-मी)
A dog.
E.
शरट् autumn, and कामिन् desirous.

n. (-लं)
The autumnal season.
E.
शरत्, and काल time.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Autumnal.
E.
शरत्काल, and ख aff.

n. (-र्व्व)
A festival, on the full moon of Āśvina, (September-October): see कोजागर.
E.
शरट् autumn, and पर्व्वन् a holiday^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-रत् or रट्)
1 The season of autumn or the sultry season; the two months succeeding the rains; according to the Vaidikas, comprising the months Bhādra and Āśvina, [] and according to the Paurāṇikas, Āśvina and Kārttika, fluctuating thus from August to

November.
2

A year.
E.
शॄ to injure, अदि Uṇādi aff.; also with टाप् added शरदा.

f. (-दा)
1 A year.
2 The sultry season.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
1 Modest, diffident.
2

New.
3

Produced in the sultry season.
4 Autumnal.
m. (-दः)
1 A year.
2 Grain or rice ripening in the sultry season.
3 A sort of kidney bean, yellow Mūṅg.
4 Autumnal sickness.
5 Sunshine, (in autumn.)
f. (-दा)
1 A name of SARASVATĪ.
2 A title of

DURGĀ.
3

A musical instrument, a sort of lute or guitar.
f. (-दी)
A plant, (Jussieua repens.)
2 A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
3 Day of full [] moon in the month Kārttika (October-November.)
E.
शरट् the autumn, and अण् aff.

f. (-दा)
1 A name of SARASVATĪ.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
सार essence, (of wisdom and eloquence,) दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Autumnal, produced in Śarat or the season of autumn.
E.
शरट् as above in the 7th case, and ज born.

m. (-धिः)
A quiver.
E.
शर an arrow, धा to have or contain, aff. कि.

n. (-खं)
Commencement of the spring season.
E.
शरट्, and मुख beginning.

m. (-तः)
An arrow's fall or flight.
E.
शर, and पात alighting.

n. (-नं)
A bowshot, an arrow's flight.
E.
शरपात, and स्थान place.

f. (-ङ्खा)
The feathers of an arrow.
E.
शर an arrow, and पुङ्ख the feathered part of it.

n. (-लं)
The blade or barb of an arrow.
E.
शर, and फल blade.

m. (-भः)
1 A fabulous animal, supposed to have eight legs, and to inhabit particularly the snowy mountains.
2 A young elephant.
3 A monkey in RAMA'S army.
4 A camel.
5 A grasshopper.
6 A locust.
E.
श to injure, Uṇādi aff. अभच् or शर an arrow, भा to shine, aff. क.

m. (-भूः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
शर the grass, and भू born; being reared in this grass.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of or consisting of Śara grass, &c.
E.
शर the grass, and मयट् aff. implying in this and other compounds change of form for any purpose except food or clothing.

m. (-ल्लः)
A small bird, considered a sa variety of the SArika or Maina, (Turdus gosalica, BUC. Mss.)
E.
शर the Śara grass, and मल्ल to hold or occupy, aff. अङ्; some authorities have शरमन्द.

f. (-युः-यू)
The Seryu or Serjū river; it is preferably, and more usually written सरयु, q. v.

m. (-युः)
Air, wind.
f. (-युः-यूः)
The Sarju or Saryu river.
E.
सृ to go, अयु Uṇādi aff.: also शरयु.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Upright, honest.
2 Crooked, fraudulent.
m. (-लः)
A tree, a sort of pine.
E.
सृ to go, कलच् aff.; and स changed to श; whence the word is preferably read सरल.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Honest, sincere, candid, upright.
2 Straight.
m. (-लः)
1 A sort of pine, (Pinus longifolia.)
2 A bird, (Pavo bicalcarata.)
f. (-ला)
A variety of the plant called Teori.
E.
सृ to go, (to spread fragrance abroad, &.,) कल Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
Sesamum.

n. (-कं)
Water.

f. (-ता)
Uprightness, sincerity.
E.
तल् added to शरल; also with त्व, शरलत्व; also सरलता.

IVA.
2
A lid, a cover.

m. (-वः)
1 A lid, a cover.
2 A shallow cup or dish.
3 A platter.
4 A measure equal to two Kuḍavas.
E.
शर mischief, (from it,) अव to preserve, aff. अण् or अच्.

m. (-वः)
A lid, or a shallow cup or saucer, used as one: see शराव.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Belonging or relating to the Saryu river.
E.
सरयु the river, अण् aff., form special.

m. (-वः)
1 KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
शर saccharum, वन a thicket or jungle, and उद्भव born: see शरजन्मन्, &c.

m. (-र्षः)
A flight or shower of arrows.
E.
शर, and वर्ष rain.

mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि)
Raining or shooting arrows.
E.
शर, and वर्षिन् showering.

m. (-णिः)
1 The head of an arrow.
2 A foot soldier, an archer.
3 A maker of arrows.
E.
शर an arrow, वण to sound, aff. इन्.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A heavy fall or shower of arrows.
E.
शर, and वृष्टि rain.

n. (-व्यं)
A mark, a butt.
E.
शरु a weapon, and यत् aff.

n. (-व्यं)
A butt or mark for shooting at.
E.
सर an arrow, व्येञ् to cover, aff. ड; also शरव्य.

m. (-तः)
Shooting, (with a bow.)
E.
शर an arrow, and आघात striking.

f. (-टि)
A sort of bird, (Turdus ginginianus.)
E.
शर water or mischief, अट to go, aff. इन्; or from अत to go, शराति; and otherwise derived also शराडि and शरालि.

m. (-टिः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A cloud.
E.
सृ to go, अटिन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-डिः)
A bird: see शरालि.

f. (-तिः)
A bird: see शराटि, &c.

m. (-सः)
Archery, practice with the bow and arrow.
E.
शर an arrow, अभ्यास exercise.

f. (-रिः)
A sort of bird, commonly the Āli or Śarāli, (Turdus ginginianus.)
E.
शर water or mischief, ऋ to go, aff. इ; also ल being substituted, शरालि, &c.

f. (-खी)
Scissars.
E.
शरारी, मुख mouth or beak, ङीष् aff.

mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु)
Mischievous, noxious, hurtful.
E.
शृ to hurt, आरु aff.

m. (-पः)
A bow.
E.
शर an arrow, आरोप a receptacle.

f. (-लिः-ली)
Śarāli A kind of bird, (Turdus ginginianus.)
E.
शर an arrow, अल to be equal to, (in speed,) aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also शरारि, शराडि, शराटि, &c., and with कन् added, fem. form शरालिका.

f. (-ती)
A river so named.
E.
शर a sort of grass, मतुप् aff. fem. form, and the final of the first word made long.

m. (-यः)
A quiver.
E.
शर an arrow, and आश्रय receptacle.

n. (-नं)
1 A bow.
2 Shooting arrows.
E.
शर an arrow, अस to throw, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 A woman's zone or girdle, formed of twentyfive strings.
2 A military belt or girdle, worn round the waist or chest, upon the coat of mail, to bind it to the body.
E.
सार strength, and षण to give, aff. अच्, or अस to diffuse, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Struck by an arrow.
E.
शर, and आहत struck.

m. (-मा)
Bearing, bringing forth.
E.
शॄ to hurt, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-मा)
1 Going, proceeding.
2 Air, wind.
E.
सृ to go, इमनिन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-रं)
The body.
E.
शॄ to injure, to be injured, Uṇādi aff. ईरन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Corporeal, bodily, belonging to or produced from the body.
2 Spiritual in connexion with the body, incorporate.
n. (-रं)
1 The soul or spirit whilst incorporate.
2 A drug (?)
3 Excrement, excretion.
m. (-रः)
Personal chastisement, corporeal punishment.
E.
शरीर the body, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 A small or delicate body.
2 The body.
E.
शरीर, and कन् diminutive, or pleonastic aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Corporeal, relating to what is corporeal.
2 Incorporate.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-णं)
Emaciating or afflicting the body.
E.
शरीर, and कर्षण attracting.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born or produced by the body, &c.
m. (-जः)
1 Sickness, disease.
2 The deity KĀMA or love.
3 A son.
E.
शरीर the body, and ज born.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Born or produced of or from the body.
E.
शरीर, and जन्मन् birth.

m. (-कः)
Decay, emaciation.
E.
शरीर, and पाक a ripening.

m. (-क)
A hostage.
E.
शरीर, and बन्धक a pledge.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Embodied, corporeal, having body.
E.
शरीर, and भाज् who shares.

f. (-त्रा)
Subsistence, support.
E.
शरीर, and यात्रा going.

m. (-गः)
Bodily union.
E.
शरीर, and योग union.

f. (-षा)
Personal attendance.
E.
शरीर, and शुश्रूषा service.

n. (-णं)
1 Drying up, withering.
2 Emaciating the body.
E.
शरीर, and शोषण drying.

m. (-रः)
Purification of the body by various ceremonies at conception, birth, initiation, death, &c.
n. (-रं)
Decoration or adorning the person.
E.
शरीर, and संस्कार making perfect.

n. (-णं)
The skin.
E.
शरीर the body, and आवरण enclosing.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Embodied, corporeal, having body.
m. (-री)
An animal or sentient being.
n. (-रि)
Life or soul connected with the body, or incorporate.
E.
शरीर body, and इनि aff.

m. (-रुः)
1 Passion, anger.
2 The thunderbolt of

INDRA.
3

An arrow.
4 Any weapon.
E.
शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. उ.

mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु)
Thin, small, fine, minute.
m. (-रुः)
The hilt or handle of a sword, &c.
E.
सृ to go, उ aff.

m. (-ष्टः)
The mango tree.
E.
शर an arrow, and इष्ट desired; the blossoms of the mango being amongst those which tip the darts of CUPID.

f. (-रा)
1 A potsherd, the fragment of a broken pot.
2 A stony nodule, or gravel.
3 A soil or spot abounding in stony or gritty fragments.
4 Clayed or candid sugar.
5 A part, a piece.
6 Gravel, (the disease.)
E.
शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. करन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Stony, gravelly.
2 Sugary.
m. (-रः)
The froth or skim of milk.
E.
शर्करा sugar, gravel, &c. aff. अण्.

f. (-भा)
The hell of gravel according to the Jainas, the second division of Tartarus.
E.
शर्करा gravel, and प्रभा illustrious.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Gritty, gravelly, full of stony particles.
E.
शर्करा gravel, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Stony, gravelly.
E.
शर्क्करा gravel, &c., and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Abounding in stony or gravelly particles, (a spot, a place.)
E.
शर्करा gravel, and इलच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (शर्घति)
To wound or kill.

m. (-र्द्धः)
Farting, a fart.
E.
शृध to fart, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं)
Joined with half, (used chiefly in composition, as सार्द्धशतं a hundred and a half, i. e. fifty.)
E.
स with, अर्द्ध half.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Causing flatulence.
m. (-हः)
Any leguminous grain or pulse, as beans, &c.
E.
शर्द्ध farting, and हा to let go or loose, aff. खश्.

r. 1st cl. (शर्ब्बति)
1 To go.
2 To hurt, to injure.

r. 1st cl. (सर्ब्बति)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्ब)
All, whole, entire.
E.
षर्ब्ब to go, aff. अच्; as differently read, with a final semivowel, सर्ब्बं q. v.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Conferring prosperity, making happy, propitious.
E.
शर्म्मन्, and द who or what gives.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Happy, glad.
n. (-र्म्म)
Happiness, pleasure.
m. (-र्म्मा)
A name or appellation common to and proper for Brahmans.
E.
शॄ to injure or destroy, (ill fortune,) मनिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Lucky, auspicious.
E.
शर्म्मन्, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A sort of garment or cloth.
f. (-रा)
A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.)
E.
शर्म्म pleasure, रा to give, aff. क.

f. (-र्य्या)
Night.
E.
शॄ to injure, यत् aff.

r. 1st cl. (शर्व्वति)
To hurt, to injure or kill.

m. (-र्व्वः)
ŚIVA.
E.
शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. व; also सर्व.

r. 1st cl. (सर्वति)
1 To go, to move.
